title: usTaxProfiles
description: This contains the US tax profile data for a given payroll profile. The US tax profile is of all the US tax setups (including federal, state, and local) for a given payee. These setups are then on file in the payroll system and can be referenced for payroll processing needs as a given scenario dictates.

taxAllowanceQuantity.description: Worker-claimed total quantity on the tax form that employers used to determine how much of the worker pay to subtract from the paycheck to remit to the tax authorities.
